title: Drowned Cache
description: A waterlogged chest sits half-buried in the sand, its iron bands green with verdigris. The bodies of its former owners lie sprawled nearby, picked clean by crabs. Whatever killed them left the cargo untouched.

choices.label: Pry it open
choices.description: The lock is rusted through and gives way easily.

outcomes.text: The lid bursts open with a spray of rust. Gold coins glimmer beneath a layer of damp cloth. A fine haul from the deep.
A modest pouch of coin and some waterlogged supplies. Not the treasure you hoped for, but useful.
A trapped mechanism fires a corroded needle into your thumb. Whatever venom coated it still carries a jolt. You pocket the coins through gritted teeth.

choices.label: Search the bodies nearby
choices.description: Their belt pouches might hold something useful.

outcomes.text: Among the remains you find vials of concentrated brine venom, still sealed. Alchemists pay well for this.
The bodies yield a single vial and a few coins. The crabs picked them fairly clean.
Disturbing the dead draws attention. A pack of shore crawlers scuttle from behind the rocks, drawn by the movement.

choices.label: Leave the dead in peace
choices.description: Disturbing the drowned invites bad luck.

outcomes.text: You step around the bodies and move on. Some things are not worth the risk.
